name: Nemo Stats: Weapons DMR
description:
Tunes the designated-marksmen rifles' damage, reloads, and spread.

Overall reduced sway, reload speed, increased durable damage, but decreased magazine size.
High caliber DMR gets AP4 on head-on hit and even bigger damage.

- R-2124 Constitution
  Still a joke weapon, but with proper damage and capacity.
- R-63 Diligence
  Headshot workhorse.
- R-2 Amendment
  Faster shooting with bayonet and burst mode at the cost of ergonomics.
- R-72 Censor
  Subsonic silenced headshot workhorse.
- R-63CS Diligence Counter Sniper
  Heavy-hitting semi-auto, AP4 on direct hit.
- R-6 Deadeye
  Precise, heavy-hitting, AP4 on direct hit.
- R-4 Hyena
  High caliber, incendiary, damage between the regular Diligence and the CS.
